sentence: The system shall create a single patient record for each patient.
The physician shall be able to view the patient chart from any workstation.
The system shall provide the ability to cosign a note and record the date and time of signature.
The system shall allow the physician to enter a new medication order for the patient.
The system shall allow the care team to update the patient's care plan.
The system shall allow the coder to assign a diagnosis code to the encounter.
The system shall display the name of the provider who signed the note.
The system shall store the reference ranges in a lookup table.
The system shall allow the user to update the patient's demographic information.
The device shall expose a serial port for data export to external systems.
The vendor shall propose a software solution that meets all functional requirements.
The user shall log in to the system using a valid session key.
Each record shall be uniquely identified using a primary key.
The system shall validate that the required field is not left blank on the form.
The system shall maintain an audit log of all user login attempts.
The system shall expose a web service for retrieving patient records.
The system shall allow the physician to review the patient's allergy list.
The system shall display the patient's date of birth on the summary screen.
The physician shall be able to sign the note electronically.
The system shall provide the capability to print a summary of the visit.
The system shall allow the nurse to document a new allergy for the patient.
The system shall display an error message on the login screen.
The system shall require the user to change the password every ninety days.
